kalde.title: Chaldean (Cheiro) numbers
kalde.lead: In the Chaldean table, 9 is not assigned to any letter; the compound number (10–52) is interpreted separately and reduced to its root.
kalde.natureLegend: — traditional nature of the compound number
kalde.caution: The root of the destiny number carries a caution mark in the traditional reading.

dual.title: The two systems side by side
dual.lead: Pythagorean and Chaldean use different letter tables; a different result for the same concept is expected. The numbers are not combined.
dual.caption: Pythagorean and Chaldean comparison
